_note: Skin-health notes per fiber or finish, shown on the card only with the cited source (CONTRACT: no claim without a source). Durability is judged by Claude; this table is health only. A fiber with no sourced note shows nothing. Notes are hedged: these are allergy risks for sensitive people, not general harm. 'checked' records how the URL was verified.

polyester.note: Some dyes used on polyester can rub off onto skin, especially with sweat, and may cause an itchy rash in sensitive people.
polyester.checked: page loads and names polyester and nylon

nylon.note: Some dyes used on nylon can rub off onto skin, especially with sweat, and may cause an itchy rash in sensitive people.
nylon.checked: page loads and names polyester and nylon

acetate.note: Acetate is dyed with the same disperse dyes linked to clothing rashes in sensitive people.
acetate.checked: page loads; acetate named in the search summary of this source

spandex.note: Stretch fibers and elastic can carry rubber chemicals that cause allergic rashes in some people where the fabric touches skin.
spandex.checked: page loads and covers clothing, underwear and elastic

wrinkle_free.note: Wrinkle-free finishes can use formaldehyde resins, which may cause skin rashes in people sensitive to it. Washing before wearing helps.
wrinkle_free.checked: official report; the site blocks automated checks, content confirmed through search results
